findings.title: Tenant admin promotion lacks owner authorization
findings.description: The route only requires a logged-in user. A tenant member can choose any tenant_id and user_id in the path and promote users without proving owner or admin rights for that tenant.

exploitability.assessment: Any authenticated user can attempt privilege escalation against another tenant.

remediation.summary: Resolve tenant_id from the authenticated principal or require a membership check that proves owner/admin role in the target tenant before updating roles.
